+On the static path (NPU, or any device with `GGML_OPENVINO_FORCE_STATIC=1`), models whose tail layers read an earlier layer's KV get a KV-only prefill by default; `GGML_OPENVINO_KV_ONLY_PREFILL=0` turns it off. It compiles the static prefill graph with only the KV-cache writes as outputs (`openvino/pass/keep_cache_results.cpp`). Everything that only feeds the logits is dropped from it: for models whose tail layers read an earlier layer's KV (Gemma 3n/4 E-series) that is every KV-shared layer, plus the LM head. When the batch needs logits, the decode graph is then run once on the output token; it rewrites that token's KV rows and computes the dropped layers against the complete cache. It is used only when attention ops of the graph share a KV cache tensor and the graph has no recurrent state. If a batch needs more than one output token, or the output step fails, the backend logs a warning and uses the full prefill from then on.

+`GGML_OPENVINO_NPU_HOST_GATHER=1` (NPU, opt-in) gathers the rows of large host-resident embedding tables (at least 64 MiB, raw GGUF data) on the host. The static graph gets the gathered rows through an `ggml_host_rows_<node>` input instead of an OpenVINO Gather over the table. NPUW otherwise lifts the table to a function input, and gathering from an input that large costs about as much as streaming the whole table every call (21.6 ms of Gemma 4 E2B decode). A table used only for such lookups (the Gemma 3n/4 per-layer embedding table) is not converted or bound to the NPU at all.

+### Example: gemma-4 E2B with the model cache
+`GGML_OPENVINO_COMPILED_MODEL_CACHE_DIR` saves the model compiled for the NPU, so only the first start compiles it. Run step 1 once, then start the model as in step 2 every later time.
+#### Step 1: first run, compile and save the model
+# This start takes longer: the backend compiles the model for the NPU and saves it in the cache directory
+# (with -lv 4 the log shows "no usable cached blobs ... compiling and exporting").
+# Use the model as usual, then exit with /exit.
+export GGML_OPENVINO_NPU_HOST_GATHER=1              # optional: faster generation, less memory and disk; the output can differ slightly
+export GGML_OPENVINO_NPU_TOKEN_EMBD_QUANT=q4_0_128  # optional: slightly less memory; may lower accuracy
+export GGML_OPENVINO_PREFILL_CHUNK_SIZE=512         # optional: can make long prompts faster; makes the first run longer
+#### Step 2: later runs, load the model from the cache
